readmes.rimenine__antigravity-status-monitor: **简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) # 反重力实时状态监控 (`antigravity-status-monitor`) 用 Antigravity 跑长任务时，主界面常常一直转着 **"Working"** 却迟迟没有输出——有时只是模型在深度思考或执行工具，但很多时候其实是 **VPN 掉线**、TUN 虚拟网卡异常或代理失效，请求早已卡死，界面却仍停留在“假性工作中”。 **反重力实时状态监控**是一个**纯本地、零第三方依赖**的右侧边栏监控面板。它实时汇总 Agent 执行阶段、宿主 `Language Server` 状态、直连/代理双链路 HTTPS 探针与 Token 消耗，让你扫一眼就能分辨「正常推进」与「静默挂起」，并在断网时给出桌面通知与就地排查入口。 - **一眼定状态**：区分模型思考、工具执行、后台任务待唤醒、接口报错重试与断网挂起，减少误中断与盲等。 - **窄栏原生体验**：适配右侧窄边栏与宽屏双栏布局，支持深浅主题自动跟随、中英双语、15 秒告警演练与即时悬停解释。 - **纯本地零外发**：仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，默认全接口令牌鉴权与严格离线 CSP；网络探测仅发极轻量连通请求，不携带账号或对话数据。 --- ## 界面预览 | 实时工作态与悬停解释 | 断网演练与就地排查 | 浅色配置与探测说明 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | > 点击任意预览图可查看原图：左图为深色工作态与页面内悬停解释浮层，中图为 15 秒断网演练及卡片内联操作，右图为浅色主题设置与展开后的「探测说明与边界」。 --- ## 工作原理 单看主界面的加载动画很难判断卡在哪一步，插件把四路直接信号拼在一起判断： 1. **Lifecycle Hooks + Transcript 阶段推断、后台任务与 API 重试识别** - [hooks.json](hooks.json) 只挂载 `PreInvocation` 与 `Stop` 两个关键事件（默认优先调用内置 `agy-node`，没装全局 Node 也能跑）； - **后台任务待唤醒（`BACKGROUND_TASK`）**：当本轮对话暂告结束但仍有后台命令/子代理未完成时，识别 `Stop` Hook 的 `fullyIdle: false`（以及 `transcript.jsonl` 未闭合后台任务兜底），展示「后台任务运行中 · 等待回调唤醒」，既不再误显示 `空闲`，也不触发 `25s` 卡顿告警，待后台结束后自动随二次唤醒回归正常流程； - **并行多工具进度与异常中止识别**：当单轮并发调用多个工具（如多个 `read_file` + `run_command`）且仅有部分快速工具回写结果时，仍保持 `工具执行中`；若 `PLANNER_RESPONSE` 带 `tool_calls` 却以 `CANCELLED`/`ERROR` 异常中止，则直接回到 `空闲`； - 只要 `transcript.jsonl` 有新输出或有新 Hook 进来，等待计时就会立刻归零；同时实时解析 `ERROR_MESSAGE`（`wsasend` 上传重置、`EOF`、`stream idle timeout`、`model unreachable`，3 分钟独立过期）及常见中间步骤，在轻探针仍绿灯但接口报错重试时直接标出 `接口重试` 并同步到本对话事件流。 2. **双链路 HTTPS 短连接探针（直连/TUN vs 代理）与分层防抖** - 按设定周期分别走直连和代理测一次短连接可达性（默认探测 `https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`，默认单次超时 `4000ms`），支持自动读取环境变量/系统代理与手动 HTTP `Basic` / 无认证 SOCKS5 代理，再结合宿主 `Language Server` 的 443 端口连接状态一起判断链路； - **分层防抖 + 混合路由纠偏 + 休眠保护**：硬断连（`ENOTFOUND`/`ECONNREFUSED`/HTTP 阻断）连续 2 次触发 `DISCONNECTED_HANG`，而纯慢超时（如 `2.5s~4s` 边缘波动）第 2 次先进入 `NET_SUSPECT` 复测、连续 3 次才升为断网挂起；若 `LS` 存在活跃代理连接且代理探针通畅而直连不通，优先采信代理链路（避免因零星直连或 `100.64.0.0/10` 运营商 CGNAT 误判成直连/TUN）；系统休眠唤醒产生的时间跳变会自动清零历史失败计数； - **自适应短连接轮询 + 严格本对话隔离**：面板前台每 1 秒通过 `/api/status` 拉取状态（`~2ms` 用完即释放连接，切到后台自动暂停并释放连接槽位，彻底避免多个 Sidecar 标签长期占满 Chromium 6 条 HTTP/1.1 连接上限导致新面板转圈或按钮无响应）。前端无任何对话切换选项，服务端也彻底移除 `auto` 切换与跨目录抢占逻辑，每个对话均使用物理分桶的实时事件流，仅展示本对话的 Hooks、工具步骤、演练预警与网络变更，随宿主切换对话时同步切换；服务端仍保留 `/api/events` SSE 接口供外部按需订阅。 3. **宿主进程追踪、分因告警防抖与自动退出** - 优先按 `ANTIGRAVITY_LS_ADDRESS` 定位当前对应的宿主 `Language Server` 进程；进程退出立刻告警，进程存活时的 `/healthz` 检测（单次超时 `3000ms`）与高负载下带健康连接的孤立 `SYN_SENT` 均需连续 2 轮确认后才告警；若 Antigravity 关掉且 `/healthz` 连续 3 次不可达，Sidecar 会自动退出； - **多会话告警评估 + 有界故障日志**：探测周期遍历当前钉选/首选活跃会话以防漏报后台对话挂起，严格区分 **VPN / 上游网络断开** 与 **Language Server 失联** 两类桌面通知文案，并将包含 `convId` 与 `message` 的完整故障/恢复记录持久化到 `.runtime/alerts.log`（有界 JSONL，自动裁剪）供事后排查。 4. **默认全接口认证 + DNS 重绑定防护 + 严格 CSP 锁定** - 仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，并在 HTTP 入口校验 `Host` 头仅允许回环地址（`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`），直接拦截 DNS 重绑定探测； - **所有 `GET /api/*` 与 `POST /api/*` 默认强制鉴权**：即使脱离宿主独立运行（未设置 `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_UI_TOKEN`），启动时也会自动生成随机 48 位 hex `uiToken`（并在控制台输出带 `?token=...` 的本机访问链接）；同时校验 `Sec-Fetch-Site`（拦截 `cross-site`）与 `Origin`（拦截 `Origin: null` 与外部域），`POST` 额外强制 `Content-Type: application/json`，Hook 上报使用独立的随机 `X-Hook-Token`（`.runtime/server.json` 不写入 `uiToken`）； - **Dashboard 响应头锁定严格 CSP**：全部静态页面与 API 响应下发 `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'`（且前端无任何内联样式/脚本），从浏览器层面物理阻断面板向任何外部域名外发数据或加载外部资源。 --- ## 已知局限与边界 这只是一个轻量的 Sidecar 状态面板，并非内核级抓包工具，以下边界需要注意： * **新建短探针能通 ≠ 旧的长连接还活着**：网络探针是周期性新建 HTTPS GET 短连接测试域名 / TLS / HTTP 是否通畅（`2xx/3xx` 及 `400/404/405/410` 视为上游有响应，因为 `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` 根路径默认返回 `404`；`401/403/407/408/429/451` 与 `5xx` 均判定为阻塞或失败）。如果只是代理节点波动导致**原本那条流式长连接或大包上传（`wsasend`）被远端重置**，在 Antigravity 写入 `ERROR_MESSAGE` 重试日志后，面板会立即标出 `接口重试`；若请求仍完全静默阻塞且尚未落盘报错、而新建探针刚好成功，则会倾向显示“网络正常 / 疑似模型卡顿”。 * **代理与 TUN 识别覆盖范围**：支持环境变量（`HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY`）、Windows 注册表 `HKCU`/`HKLM`（含 `ProxyOverride` 绕过列表与 `DefaultConnectionSettings` 开关校验）、macOS `scutil`（含 `ExceptionsList`）、Linux GNOME `gsettings`（含 `ignore-hosts`）中的 **HTTP 代理**（含基础 `Basic` 鉴权）与**无认证 SOCKS5 代理**，并支持设置面板里的**「手动代理」**兜底（适合 PAC、非 GNOME 桌面、纯 SOCKS5 等场景）；**暂不支持解析 PAC 脚本（会给提示）、`https://`/`socks4://` 代理、带密码的 SOCKS5、企业 NTLM 域认证或按进程注入式透明分流工具；公司网关若使用了未导入 Node 信任链的中间人自签根证书，也可能报 TLS 失败**。TUN 网卡基于 `198.18.0.0/15`（Fake-IP）与 `100.64.0.0/10`（CGNAT / Tailscale / WireGuard 等常见段）做启发式归类；若同时存在活跃代理连接且仅代理探针通畅，插件会自动纠偏优先采用代理探测结果（避免因运营商宽带也使用 `100.64.0.0/10` 而误判）。 * **超时阈值与高思考强度模型**：默认单次网络探测超时为 `4000ms`（纯超时需连续 `3` 次才触发断网挂起，硬错误连续 `2` 次触发）；Antigravity 通常在整轮思考/回复生成完毕后才落盘 `PLANNER_RESPONSE`，因此使用高思考强度模型单轮耗时超过 `25s` 属正常现象，可在设置中将卡顿预警阈值调至 `45s`。 * **Hooks 与常驻开销**：Antigravity 每次 `PreInvocation` / `Stop` 时会拉起一次短暂的轻量 Hook 进程；Sidecar 本身为常驻本地 Node 进程。 * **本地接口访问范围**：即使仅绑定 `127.0.0.1`，全部 `GET /api/*`（含 `/api/status`、`/api/events`）与 `POST /api/*` 均默认强制校验 `X-Sidecar-Token`（或 SSE 使用的 `?token=`）、`Host` 回环白名单、`Sec-Fetch-Site` 与 `Origin`；未授权网页或未携带 Token 的本机请求会被直接拦截（`401`/`403`）。 * **Token 统计口径**：`total` 直接累加 `input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + output_tokens` 的原始次数，用来直观感受工作量与缓存命中趋势即可，不能直接等同于官方计费或配额扣减；当前会话优先走 Hook 上报路径，全量历史统计扫描 `transcript.jsonl`（不存在时回退 `transcript_full.jsonl`）。 * **本地告警日志与弹窗控制**：Sidecar 仅在本地 `.runtime/alerts.log` 保留有界裁剪后的关键告警/恢复摘要 JSONL（默认上限 `64 KB` / 最近 `120` 条），不上传任何外部服务；指定 `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR` 时会严格隔离 `brain/` 扫描范围，无头测试或自动化脚本可通过 `ASM_DISABLE_NOTIFICATIONS=1` 静默系统桌面弹窗。 --- ## 跨平台支持矩阵 | 平台 | HTTPS 可达性探针 | 系统代理探测 | Language Server & 443 套接字检测 | 系统桌面通知 | 验证程度 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Windows** | 支持 | 环境变量 + 注册表 `HKCU`/`HKLM`（HTTP / SOCKS5 / `ProxyOverride`；PAC 提示不支持，可手动指定代理） | `netstat -ano -p TCP` + `tasklist` + CIM | PowerShell WinRT Toast 通知 | **实机长运行验证** + CI 集成测试 | | **macOS** | 支持 | 环境变量 + `scutil --proxy`（HTTP / SOCKS5；PAC 提示不支持，可手动指定代理） | `lsof -nP -iTCP` + `pgrep`/`ps` | `osascript` 系统通知 | 单元测试 + GitHub Actions macOS CI | | **Linux** | 支持 | 环境变量（含 `ALL_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY`）+ GNOME `gsettings`（HTTP/SOCKS/PAC；非 GNOME 可用环境变量或手动代理） | `ss -tnap`（回退 `lsof`）+ `pgrep`/`ps` | `notify-send` | 单元测试 + GitHub Actions Ubuntu CI | --- ## 快速安装与卸载 ### 方式一：让反重力 (Antigravity) 帮你自动下载并安装（推荐，零 Git / 零命令行） 不会用 Git 或命令行也没关系。新建一个 Antigravity 对话，直接复制下面这段话发给它，反重力会自动完成下载、校验、解压与安装（已有 `.runtime/config.json` 配置也会原样保留）： ```text 请帮我下载并安装（或更新）反重力状态监控插件 Antigravity Status Monitor： 1. 从 https://github.com/rimenine/antigravity-status-monitor/releases/latest 下载适合我当前系统的安装包（Windows 用 agent-status-monitor.zip，macOS / Linux 用 agent-status-monitor.tar.gz），如有 SHA256SUMS.txt 请先校验文件完整性；若暂无预打包 Release，则改用主分支源码包。 2. 解压到临时目录后，运行其中的 install.ps1（Windows）或 install.sh（macOS / Linux）完成安装，脚本会自动保留我原有的 .runtime/config.json。 3. 安装完成后清理临时目录，并验证插件文件与面板入口是否就绪。 ``` > 升级插件同样适用：把同一段话再发给 Antigravity 一次，它会自动停止旧版 Sidecar、替换运行文件并保留你的预警阈值与通知配置。 ### 方式二：手动下载 Releases 压缩包或命令行安装 前后端无任何第三方依赖，可直接下载 [Releases](https://github.com/rimenine/antigravity-status-monitor/releases/latest) 中的预打包压缩包（附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`），解压到任意目录运行安装脚本（或直接将包内 `agent-status-monitor/` 目录解压放进 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`），也可以直接执行一行安装命令： ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell 一键拉取最新安装包并安装) $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "asm-install"; Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/rimenine/antigravity-status-monitor/releases/latest/download/agent-status-monitor.zip" -OutFile "$tmp\asm.zip" Expand-Archive "$tmp\asm.zip" -DestinationPath $tmp -Force powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$tmp\agent-status-monitor\install.ps1" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux (一键拉取最新安装包并安装) TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" && curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rimenine/antigravity-status-monitor/releases/latest/download/agent-status-monitor.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$TMP_DIR" && sh # Context Radar MCP **See how full your Antigravity context really is, why a turn got slow, and when it's actually worth compacting or starting fresh.** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp?color=D97757&label=release)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Why this exists Long coding sessions in Antigravity tend to slow down and get expensive without telling you why. Maybe one huge file dump ate half the window, maybe something broke the prompt cache mid-turn, or maybe you ran `/compact` too early and threw away a warm cache for nothing. Context Radar puts a live status panel in Antigravity so you can see what is going on and let your agent make smarter decisions about trimming history or handing off to a new chat. ## What it does - **Live context and cost meter**: Shows how much of your context window is used across the current chat and any running subagents, along with cache hit rate, response speed, and estimated cost. - **Explains slow turns**: Tells the difference between a normal new-turn cache miss, an unexpected mid-loop cache break, and a post-compact rebuild, so you know what actually slowed things down. - **Finds and trims bloated history**: Points out the specific turns that caused context spikes and lets your agent save a short summary of old work into `scratch/` instead of dragging raw logs around. - **Smarter `/compact` and fresh-chat handoffs**: Checks whether compacting or moving to a new conversation will actually save tokens over the next few turns, then gives you a one-click handoff card when it's time. - **Helpful optional guardrails**: Can gently keep the agent from backgrounding short shell commands too early, and optionally inject a short workspace status file at session start if you configure one. ## Install ### macOS & Linux (recommended) ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` This downloads the prebuilt binary for your platform (macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, or Linux x86_64), checks its SHA-256 hash, and installs the plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp`. Restart or reload Antigravity afterward to pick it up. To pin a specific release or custom plugin folder: ```sh CONTEXT_RADAR_VERSION=v1.0.0 ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR=~/.gemini/config/plugins \ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ## How to use it ### In Antigravity Open **Context Radar** from the Antigravity side pane to watch your live context gauge, turn history, and cache health. You can also just ask your agent in plain language. The plugin includes an on-demand skill so the agent knows how to read the numbers and act on them: - *"Open Context Radar and show me how full this session is."* - *"Why did the last few turns get slow? Did the cache break?"* - *"Find which turns bloated the context and summarize them."* - *"Is it worth running `/compact` now, or should we hand off to a new chat?"* ### Tools available to your agent | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `context_radar_overview` | Opens the live panel and returns the current session and subagent summary. | | `context_radar_turns` | Breaks down per-turn tokens, cache hits, cache-miss causes, speed, and estimated cost. | | `context_radar_hotspots` | Finds the biggest context spikes in the conversation and summarizes selected slices to `scratch/`. | | `context_radar_prepare_handoff` | Checks whether `/compact` or a fresh session makes sense right now. | | `context_radar_commit_handoff` | Creates the one-click `/compact` or new-conversation handoff card once checks pass. | ## Configuration (optional) No config file is needed out of the box. If you want custom model pricing, display currency, budget thresholds, or workspace startup notes, copy [settings.example.json](settings.example.json) to `~/.config/context-radar-mcp/settings.json`. If your Antigravity data lives in a non-default folder, you can override it with `CONTEXT_RADAR_DATA_ROOT` (defaults to `~/.gemini/antigravity`) or point to a custom settings file with `CONTEXT_RADAR_CONFIG`. ## Privacy Everything runs locally on your machine with zero network requests and no telemetry. Context Radar opens Antigravity's local database strictly in read-only mode, so it never edits or locks your conversation history. ## Build from source Requires Rust (`cargo`) and Node.js 20+ (only to bundle and test the panel). ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar-mcp.git cd context-radar-mcp node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/panel.test.mjs cargo test --locked cargo build --release --locked ``` ## Contributing & License Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# Chrome Stream MCP **View and interact with your own local Google Chrome tabs right inside Antigravity, even over a slow phone or remote connection.** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp?color=D97757&label=release)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Why this exists Sometimes you just want to check a page, click a button, or finish a login inside your real local Google Chrome (where your accounts and extensions already live) without leaving Antigravity. That's especially handy when you're controlling your workstation remotely from a phone over mobile data. Chrome Stream MCP streams your local Chrome tabs into an interactive Antigravity panel and adjusts image quality automatically so it stays usable even on slow connections. ## What it does - **Interactive local Chrome in Antigravity**: Click, type, scroll, navigate, and switch, open, or close tabs in your real local Chrome window directly from the panel. - **Click "Allow" once per browser session**: Keeps a background local relay connected so Chrome doesn't keep popping up the debugging approval prompt whenever the plugin reloads. - **You control when it connects**: Opening the panel never connects to Chrome behind your back. Use **Connect**, **Pause / Resume**, and **Disconnect** right in the header, and screen capture automatically rests when idle to save battery. - **Built for slow connections**: Automatically adapts image quality across four presets based on your connection latency, and skips sending frames when nothing on the page changed. - **Normal tab behavior**: Closing the last tab shows a clean empty state instead of forcing an unwanted `about:blank` tab back open. ## Install & Setup ### 1. Install the plugin (macOS & Linux) ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` This downloads the prebuilt binary for your platform (macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, or Linux x86_64), verifies its SHA-256 hash, and installs it into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp`. Restart or reload Antigravity afterward. To pin a specific release: ```sh CHROME_STREAM_VERSION=v0.1.0 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 2. Turn on Chrome remote debugging (one-time) 1. Keep Google Chrome open on your computer. 2. Open `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` in Chrome and enable remote debugging (or launch Chrome locally with `--remote-debugging-port=9222`). 3. Open **Chrome Stream** in Antigravity, click **Connect**, and click **Allow** once when Chrome asks. If Chrome doesn't connect, run `chrome-stream-mcp doctor` in a terminal to see what's missing. ## How to use it ### In the panel Click **Connect** to start viewing your active tab. Use the tab bar, address bar, and mouse/keyboard just like a normal browser. Click **Pause** whenever you want to freeze the stream without losing authorization, or **Disconnect** when you're done to close the Chrome connection. ### Ask your agent Chrome Stream ships an on-demand skill (with zero always-on prompt overhead), so you can also control it from chat: - *"Open Chrome Stream."* - *"Connect Chrome Stream to my local Chrome."* - *"Disconnect Chrome Stream when we're done."* | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `chrome_stream_stage` | Opens the Chrome Stream panel and shows connection status without auto-connecting. | | `chrome_stream_connect` | Connects to your local Chrome session and starts streaming the active tab. | | `chrome_stream_disconnect` | Stops streaming and closes the Chrome debugging connection. | ### Custom Chrome port or profile (optional) By default, Chrome Stream finds your running Chrome automatically (with localhost port `9222` as fallback). If you run a custom setup, you can set `CHROME_STREAM_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT` or `CHROME_STREAM_CHROME_PORT_FILE`. ## Privacy & Security Chrome Stream only connects to Google Chrome on `localhost` (`127.0.0.1` / `::1`) and refuses non-local addresses. Never expose Chrome's remote debugging port to the public network. Local file paths and internal WebSocket tokens are stripped before anything is returned to the agent, and the plugin makes no outbound network requests. ## Build from source Requires Rust (`cargo`) and Node.js 20+ (only to build and test the panel; no npm dependencies). ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp.git cd chrome-stream-mcp node panel/build.mjs && node --test panel/net-policy.test.mjs cargo test --locked cargo build --release --locked ``` ## Contributing & License Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

## Features - **Lid / Power / Thermal Policy Engine** — Continuously evaluates `AppleClamshellState`, AC vs. battery power, low-battery threshold (`<= 20%`), Apple Silicon P/E-core topology, and `pmset -g therm` pressure into four tiers (`normal`, `utility`, `eco`, `strict`). - **Display Thermal Guard (`watch`)** — Automatically dims the built-in backlight to `0%` and sleeps the internal display whenever the lid closes (even when apps hold `NoDisplaySleepAssertion`), skips redundant CoreGraphics/disk work in steady state, fails safe on `ioreg` timeouts, and retries across lid-open wake races. - **Apple Silicon & macOS Brightness Control** — Direct `dlopen`/`dlsym` FFI bindings to `CoreGraphics` (`CGGetOnlineDisplayList`, `CGDisplayIsBuiltin`, `CGDisplayIsAsleep`) and `DisplayServices` (`DisplayServicesGetBrightness`, `DisplayServicesSetBrightness`). Adjusts `0%–100%` brightness immediately while open and awake, or safely updates the wake-restore target while closed without lighting the closed panel — synchronized via `O_NOFOLLOW` `flock` (`0600`). - **Adaptive `run` Wrapper** — Wraps heavy builds, tests, and scripts with live `taskpolicy` (`-c utility` / `-c background` / `-b`), `nice`, and 10 concurrency environment variables (`MAKEFLAGS`, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS`, `CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL`, `OMP_NUM_THREADS`, `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS`, `MKL_NUM_THREADS`, `VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS`, `RAYON_NUM_THREADS`, `UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE`, `GOMAXPROCS`). - **Zero-Flicker MCP Dashboard (`ui://mac-clamshell-mcp/panel`)** — Self-contained SEP-1865 (`2026-01-26`) single-file HTML (`<38 KiB`, `default-src 'none'`, zero external URLs), dark-first frame-0 lock (`#141311`) with transparent host CSS variable protection, startup pre-warm + single-flight SWR cache (`<0.5 ms` SSR `resources/read`), SHA-256 ETag `unchanged: true` deduplication, RTT-adaptive polling with `document.hidden` pause, optimistic controls, and a `250ms` debounced last-write-wins brightness slider. ### Adaptive Profile Tiers | Profile | Trigger | Scheduler / QoS | Concurrency (`max_jobs`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Normal** | Lid open, thermal OK | Unrestricted | All logical cores | | **Utility** | Lid closed + AC power | `taskpolicy -c utility`, `nice 10` | E-cores (`2..4`) | | **Eco** | Lid closed + Battery | `taskpolicy -c background`, `nice 15` | `<= 2` (`1` when battery `<= 20%`) | | **Strict** | Thermal warning / throttle | `taskpolicy -b`, `nice 19` | `1` | ## Architecture

1. **macOS Hardware & FFI (`src/platform/`)** reads lid state (`IOKit`), power/thermal pressure (`pmset`), CPU topology & memory (`sysctlbyname`, `getloadavg`, Mach `host_statistics64`), and built-in display state (`CoreGraphics` + `DisplayServices` `dlopen` FFI). 2. **Policy & Guard Core (`src/policy.rs`, `src/guard.rs`, `src/state.rs`, `src/runner.rs`)** resolves the active 4-tier profile, coordinates closed-lid backlight dimming & wake restoration under `O_NOFOLLOW` `flock`, and wraps heavy commands with `taskpolicy`/`nice`/concurrency caps. 3. **Runtime Surfaces (`src/cli.rs`, `src/hook.rs`, `src/mcp/`)** exposes a single stripped Rust binary for CLI commands, `~1–3 ms` fail-open lifecycle hooks, the LaunchAgent display guard, and a pre-warmed SWR JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server. 4. **Agent & MCP Dashboard (`panel/`, `plugin/`)** delivers an editorial-warm `<38 KiB` SEP-1865 HTML panel, `<400 B` always-on rules, and an on-demand agent skill. ## Quick Install ### One-Line Release Installer (macOS Apple Silicon & Intel) Downloads the matching `aarch64-apple-darwin` or `x86_64-apple-darwin` release archive, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and installs cleanly into `${ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR:-$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins}/mac-clamshell-mcp`: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Pin a specific version or destination: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --version v1.0.0 ``` ### Build from Source Requirements: macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), Rust toolchain (`cargo`), and Node.js 20+ (to bundle `panel/dist/panel.html`). ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp.git cd mac-clamshell-mcp # 1. Pack and test the lean SEP-1865 panel HTML (cd panel && npm install) && node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/test/panel.test.mjs # 2. Install into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp (atomic binary swap) ./scripts/install-plugin.sh ``` ### Optional macOS LaunchAgent (Background Display Thermal Guard) Install and load `~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.mac-clamshell-mcp.display-guard.plist` so your built-in display stays safely dimmed and asleep whenever the lid closes (even outside agent sessions): ```sh ./scripts/install-launchagent.sh --interval 10 ``` ## Agent Integration & Skill `mac-clamshell-mcp` uses **low-intrusion progressive disclosure** so agent context stays virtually untouched during normal open-lid work: - **`plugin/rules/AGENTS.md` (`<400 B`)** — Tiny plain-markdown always-on rule telling the agent to operate normally unless an active `[mac-clamshell]` throttle notice appears. - **`plugin/skills/mac-clamshell/SKILL.md`** — On-demand skill loaded only when throttled (`utility`, `eco`, `strict`) or when the user asks about clamshell status, build wrapping, or built-in brightness. - **`plugin/hooks.json`** — Runs `mac-clamshell-mcp hook session-start` and `pre-invocation` with an early-exit balanced-JSON stdin reader (`~1–3 ms`, always fail-open). # AGY Git Graph 🌿

> **Visual Git branch graph and commit diff viewer for AGY Auxiliary Pane.**  
> **專為 Antigravity (AGY) 輔助面板打造的 Git 視覺化分支圖與 Commit Diff 檢視器。**

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-v1.0.8-orange.svg)](https://github.com/Commit-Or-Die-Studio/agy-git-graph/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform: Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Antigravity%20(AGY)-673ab7.svg)](#)
[![Zero Dependency](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero%20(Native%20Node.js)-success.svg)](#)

---

## 📖 簡介 / Overview

**AGY Git Graph** 是專為 **Antigravity (AGY) 桌面版** 量身打造的原生 UI 外掛（UI Plugin / Sidecar）。  
常駐於 AGY 右側輔助面板（Auxiliary Pane，約 350px~500px 寬度），以流暢彩色的多軌平滑曲線直觀呈現專案的分支走向、Merge 線條、Commit 歷史與變更檔案 Diff，支援公司 Organization 私有儲存庫、Submodule 子模組切換與純本地離線運作。

**AGY Git Graph** is a native UI Plugin & Sidecar tailored for the **Antigravity (AGY) Desktop App**.  
It embeds seamlessly into the AGY Auxiliary Pane (~350px-500px), rendering smooth multi-lane Bezier curves for branch trajectories, merge topologies, commit histories, and inline file diffs—fully offline and private-repo friendly with zero external dependencies.

---

## ✨ 核心特點 / Key Features

* 🚀 **純本地零依賴 (Zero External Dependencies)**  
  後端採用原生 Node.js（`node:http`、`node:child_process`、`node:fs`、`node:sqlite`），無需執行 `npm install` 下載龐大套件，啟動最輕量迅速。  
  *Powered entirely by native Node.js standard libraries—no external npm modules needed.*

* 🎨 **彩色多軌平滑分支圖與合體分支標籤 (Multi-Lane Smooth Curves & Synced Badges)**  
  內建分支軌道演算法繪製平滑貝茲曲線（Bezier Curves）；當本地分支與遠端分支同步於同一 Commit 時，自動合併為單一漸層標籤（如 `[ ⎇ main ☁ ]`），精簡側邊欄空間。  
  *Dynamic multi-lane layout with unified local/remote synced branch badges.*

* 📱 **完美適配 AGY 側邊欄 (Tailored for Auxiliary Pane)**  
  針對 350px~500px 寬度設計響應式暗色系介面，支援 Commit 關鍵字搜尋、分支下拉即時篩選與絕對時間戳記（`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`）。  
  *Responsive dark-themed UI specifically tuned for 350px–500px panes with instant commit search and branch filters.*

* 🔍 **即時 Commit 詳情、Working Tree 與 Diff 獨立視窗 (Details, Working Tree & Popout Diff)**  
  點擊任一 Commit 或頂部工作區狀態列即可展開修改檔案清單（`[A]`、`[M]`、`[D]`、`[U]`），支援樹狀/列表檢視與一鍵彈出獨立大視窗檢視語法高亮 Diff。  
  *Click any commit or the working-tree status bar to inspect modified files and view syntax-highlighted diffs inline or in a popout window.*

* 🏢 **支援多專案、Submodule 子模組與私有倉庫切換 (Multi-Repo & Submodule Switch)**  
  完全在本地執行 `git` 指令，安全無資安疑慮；內建 AGY 專案與 Git Submodule 階層選單，亦支援手動輸入任意本機倉庫路徑。  
  *Local execution ensures 100% security for corporate private repos with built-in AGY project and submodule selector.*

* 🔔 **GitHub 新版偵測與一鍵熱更新 (Release Update Notification & One-Click Hot Update)**  
  自動比對 GitHub 最新 Release 版本，當有新版本發布時於面板右上角顯示 `⬆ vX.Y.Z` 提示按鈕；點擊即可自動下載更新包、校驗 `SHA256SUMS.txt`、覆蓋安裝並自動熱重啟面板，無須重開 AGY。  
  *Automatically detects new GitHub Releases and displays an update pill in the toolbar for one-click SHA-256 verified hot updating.*

---

## 📁 專案架構 / Directory Structure

```text
agy-git-graph/
├── plugin.json                 # AGY Plugin Manifest 清單設定檔
├── package.json                # 專案資訊與打包腳本配置

├── assets/
│   └── logo.svg                # 外掛專屬圖示
├── sidecars/
│   └── git_graph_server/       # Sidecar 核心伺服器與前端 UI
│       ├── sidecar.json        # AGY Sidecar 描述設定檔 (AUX_PANE 進入點)
│       ├── server.mjs          # Node.js 輕量 HTTP 伺服器與 Git 解析器
```

## 📦 安裝與解除安裝 / Install & Uninstall

請至 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Commit-Or-Die-Studio/agy-git-graph/releases) 下載最新版本的安裝檔：

| 平台 | 檔案名稱 | 用途說明 |

| **Windows** | `agy-git-graph-v<VERSION>-uninstall.exe` | **Windows 解除安裝檔**：雙擊自動關閉背景程序並完整移除外掛 |

## 🛠️ 本地開發與打包 / Local Development & Packaging

### 1. 啟動本機測試伺服器
```bash
node sidecars/git_graph_server/server.mjs
```
伺服器預設將在 `http://127.0.0.1:52888` 啟動。

### 2. 本機預覽打包（不更動工作區版號）
```bash

```
會在 `dist/` 目錄下直接產出**下一版本號**的安裝檔與壓縮包，方便本地安裝實測且不與已發布的舊版號混淆。

# 思语中文 · Think-ZH (`antigravity-think-zh`)

[English Documentation](./README.en.md)

面向 **Google Antigravity** 的零依赖思考语言控制插件：引导模型从第一个字起全程使用**简体中文**进行内部思考与推理（`thinking / reasoning`），同时严格保留代码、标识符、文件路径、命令行与报错原文不强行翻译，并支持随时一键切回**默认英文思考**。

> **致谢**：本插件的核心规则与双通道强化思路受开源项目 [`Len7183/DSH-Think-zh`](https://github.com/Len7183/DSH-Think-zh)（MIT）启发，并结合 Antigravity 原生插件架构（Rules + Lifecycle Hooks + 外接模型智能识别 + MCP Server + Sidecar UI）重新设计与实现。

---

## ✨ 功能全景

### 1. 双档位思考语言预设（即时热切换）
- **简体中文思考（默认推荐，`zh`）**：
  - 要求模型内部思考与推理（涵盖任务分析、方案规划、工具调用前后推理、日志排查、报错诊断与最终自查）从第一个字起全程使用简体中文，禁止先用英文起草再翻译；
  - 即使提问、代码、报错、路径或工具输出为英文，内部思考仍保持简体中文；
  - 代码、标识符、文件路径、命令行与报错原文保持原样；最终回复跟随用户最近一条实质提问语言。

# AGY Ext Swarm — External Multi-CLI Agent Swarm Plugin for Antigravity

> **[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md)** | English

An open-source Antigravity (AGY) plugin that lets Antigravity act as the **Coordinator** (architect, task splitter, diff reviewer, and merger) while orchestrating external headless coding CLI workers across **`dsh` (DeepSeek Harness)**, **Claude Code (`claude`)**, **OpenAI Codex (`codex`)**, **Gemini CLI (`gemini`)**, or **any custom CLI command** over a shared message board.

![AGY Ext Swarm Side-Pane Preview](./assets/preview.svg)

## Key Capabilities

- **Multi-CLI Model Auto-Discovery, Scene Routing & Orchestration Sub-Tabs**: Automatically probes local caches & CLI model lists (`app_discover_models`) with a checkbox model picker and grouped `dsh` multi-provider selection, binds model preferences by task scene (`task_routing` / `task_type`), lets you configure AGY Orchestrator delegation boundaries (`balanced` / `prefer-external` / `manual-only`), and separates Settings into focused `CLIs & Models` and `Orchestration & Routing` sub-tabs.
- **First-Time CLI & Model Onboarding Wizard**: Automatically launches on first run to probe local CLIs, pick enabled backends and default models, optionally split Writer/Reader routing pools, and save everything in one batch.
- **Zero-Setup AI Auto-Delegation (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Includes an always-on plugin rule that guides Antigravity to automatically compose and launch CLI squads for multi-module coding, batch tasks, broad research, or cross-review without manual squad setup—while staying out of the way for small single-file edits or when disabled.
- **Pluggable External CLI Providers & One-Click Presets**: Auto-detects available CLIs across macOS, Linux, and Windows (`PATH`/`PATHEXT`), with one-click templates for popular coding CLIs (**OpenCode**, **Aider**, **Qwen Code**, **Goose**) plus inline `custom_command` or `providers.json`.
- **Interactive UI Commander & Settings**: Create swarms, launch workers (with `depends_on` DAG dependencies, `allowed_files` whitelists, and `verify_commands`/`auto_verify`), start Multi-CLI Arenas, apply Team Playbook Templates (or generate templates from the current swarm), configure CLI binaries/models/pricing/custom `env` (`KEY=VALUE`), inspect live elapsed duration badges, `Kill & Clean` / `Kill All` worktrees, compose multiline messages (`Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline) with focus-safe polling, and preview/merge worktrees directly from the side-pane UI.
- **Deterministic DAG Orchestration (`depends_on`)**: Downstream workers queue as `blocked`, ignore premature `@all` / peer wakes, unlock automatically with upstream diffs & board summaries once dependencies succeed, and fail safely without deadlock if upstream breaks.
- **Zero-Side-Effect Conflict Preview & Safe Merge (`ext_swarm_merge`)**: Uses `git merge-tree --write-tree` to detect conflicts without touching the working tree, then merges cleanly via `squash`, `cherry-pick`, or `merge` with automatic abort-on-error and optional worktree cleanup.
- **Multi-CLI Arena & Cross-Vendor Auto Review**: Race 2+ CLI backends in parallel isolated worktrees (`ext_swarm_arena`), compare commits/diff/tokens side by side, and trigger another CLI vendor to perform a read-only audit (`ext_swarm_cross_review`).
- **Reusable Team Templates (`templates.json`)**: Ships with built-in playbooks (`feature-squad`, `bug-hunt`, `doc-and-test`) merged with global/repo `templates.json`.
- **Shared Message Board, Timeouts & Watchdog**: Append-only `board.jsonl` with `@name`, `@group`, `@all`, `@coordinator`, `max_hops`, hard `turn_timeout_seconds`, and silence `stall_timeout_seconds` watchdog.
- **Session Resume & In-Place Switch / Retry**: Captures `sessionId` / `thread_id` across follow-up wakes and lets you retry failed workers or switch their `provider` / `model` in place while preserving their existing `git worktree` and branch.
- **Git Worktree Isolation, Colored Diff Drawer & Auto Verify**: Parallel writers run in isolated `git worktree` branches (`ext-swarm/<swarmId>/<worker>`); optional `allowed_files` whitelists check out-of-scope edits mechanically, `auto_verify: true` deterministically runs `verify_commands` host-side after each turn, and the Workers tab includes a full colored Git Diff drawer.
- **Unified Token, Cache & Cost Telemetry + Markdown Export**: Tracks **AGY Main Model** (including **AGY Orchestrator (Plan/Execute)** multi-model breakdowns via `byModelSession` / `byModelSinceSwarm`) and **External CLI Workers** side-by-side (`cacheRead / (input + cacheRead)`), calculates optional estimated costs when model rates are set, and supports exporting full Markdown post-mortem reports (`ext_swarm_export`) or cleaning up historical swarms (`ext_swarm_delete`).
- **Bilingual Side-Pane MCP App (`中 / EN`)**: Interactive Board, curved Bezier Graph & Replay scrubber (with DAG edges), Workers Commander + Event/Diff/Merge Drawers, Usage Dashboard, and Settings Center.

## Supported CLI Providers

| Provider ID | CLI Command | Session Resume | Streaming Events | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh` | `dsh` (`$DSH_BIN`) | `--session-id` | NDJSON (`--json`) | Supports `--patch` per-worker model overrides via `cordis.patch.yml`. |
| `claude` | `claude` (`$CLAUDE_BIN`) | `--resume` | `stream-json` | Maps permission presets to `plan` / `acceptEdits` / `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. |
| `codex` | `codex` (`$CODEX_BIN`) | `exec resume` | JSONL (`--json`) | Runs `codex exec` / `codex exec resume` with `--sandbox`. |
| `gemini` | `gemini` (`$GEMINI_BIN`) | `--resume` | `stream-json` | Runs `gemini -p --output-format stream-json`. |
| `custom` / `<id>` | Any executable | Optional `resumeArgs` | `text` or `ndjson` | Inline via `custom_command` or defined in `providers.json`. |

### Auto-Detection & `providers.json`

When `default_provider` is omitted in `ext_swarm_create`, AGY Ext Swarm automatically picks:
1. `"defaultProvider"` from `<repo_root>/.agy-ext-swarm/providers.json` or `${PLUGIN_DATA}/providers.json`, if set;
2. Otherwise the first built-in CLI found on `PATH` (`dsh` -> `claude` -> `codex` -> `gemini`);
3. Otherwise the first available custom provider.

Example `providers.json`:

```json
{
  "defaultProvider": "my-agent",
  "providers": {
    "my-agent": {
      "displayName": "My Local Coding CLI",
      "command": "my-agent-cli",
      "args": ["--cwd", "{{cwd}}", "--model", "{{model}}", "-p", "{{prompt}}"],
      "resumeArgs": ["--cwd", "{{cwd}}", "--resume", "{{sessionId}}", "-p", "{{prompt}}"],
      "promptMode": "arg",
      "outputFormat": "text",
      "defaultModel": "default",
      "models": ["default", "fast"]
    }
  }
}
```

Supported template variables in `args` / `resumeArgs`:
`{{prompt}}`, `{{model}}`, `{{cwd}}`, `{{sessionId}}`, `{{permissionMode}}`, `{{workerName}}`, `{{swarmDir}}`, `{{gitCommonDir}}`, `{{boardCli}}`.

## Installation & Build

The repository ships **zero-dependency self-contained runtime bundles** (`server/dist/index.mjs` and `server/dist/board.html`, requiring no `node_modules` or `pnpm` at runtime). Choose any of the following installation methods:

### 1. For `agy` CLI Users (Direct Repository Install)

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/ycuwq/agy-ext-swarm
```

### 2. For Antigravity Desktop App Users — `npx` One-Command Install (Recommended, Cross-Platform)

Requires only `Node.js >= 20` (no `git`, `pnpm`, or `agy` CLI needed). Automatically copies the self-contained plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ext-swarm` while preserving `.data/` across upgrades:

```bash
npx -y agy-ext-swarm install
```

Useful management commands:
```bash
npx -y agy-ext-swarm status               # Inspect install path, version, and bundle health
npx -y agy-ext-swarm install --workspace  # Install into ./.agents/plugins for team/repo sharing
npx -y agy-ext-swarm uninstall            # Uninstall the global plugin
```

### 3. GitHub Release One-Liners & Offline Archives (No `npm` Required)

- **macOS / Linux**:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ycuwq/agy-ext-swarm/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
  ```
- **Windows (PowerShell)**:
  ```powershell
  irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ycuwq/agy-ext-swarm/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
  ```
- **Manual Offline Install**: Download `agy-ext-swarm.tar.gz` or `agy-ext-swarm.zip` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ycuwq/agy-ext-swarm/releases) and extract the `agy-ext-swarm/` folder into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` (or `.agents/plugins/`). No `pnpm install` step is needed.

### 4. From Source (Contributors & Local Development)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ycuwq/agy-ext-swarm.git
cd agy-ext-swarm
node scripts/install.mjs         # Symlink/junction from git checkout (--copy for standalone copy, --build to rebuild)
```

```bash
cd agy-ext-swarm/server
pnpm install

```

Requirements: `Node.js >= 20`, `git` (`>= 2.38` recommended for `git merge-tree --write-tree`), and at least one CLI provider (`dsh`, `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, or a custom command).

### Notes on `dsh` Profile Isolation

If using `dsh`, never modify `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` (locked by the desktop client). Configure your chosen `headless` (or custom) profile via `dsh` (and ensure any desired model catalog entries are populated in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` or configured in the **Settings** tab / `providers.json`). # antigravity-research-flash-lite

A deterministic `PreToolUse` hook, Python helper script, and agent configuration suite for Google Antigravity that rewrites `invoke_subagent` calls targeting **only the `research` subagent** to `Model: "flash_lite"` (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`) before execution.

> [!NOTE]
> **Scope of savings**: Quota savings apply **strictly to delegated `research` subagent calls** (`TypeName="research"`). Your primary session turns, `worker` edits, `self` subagents, and non-`research` tool calls continue consuming your selected frontier model quota as usual. Actual overall session savings depend on how much read-heavy exploration you delegate to `research`.

On fresh single-dispatch `agy -p` `research` benchmarks (Gemini AI Pro), routing `research` calls to `flash_lite` reduces the `research` subagent's own quota drain to **`< 0.01%` (`0.00%` measured)** — cutting benchmark-run drain by **2.67x** on **Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)**, **4.26x** on **Gemini 4 Neon (High)**, **3.26x** on **Gemini 4 Argon (High)**, and keeping **Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium)** subagent drain at **0.00%**.

![Research Subagent Quota Drain Comparison](./assets/benchmark-savings.svg)

---

## Why This Hook Is Essential

Antigravity's `invoke_subagent` tool schema defaults its `Model` parameter to `'inherit'` (`['inherit', 'flash_lite', 'flash', 'pro']`). The system prompt instructs parent agents to default to `'inherit'` unless explicitly requested otherwise.

When your main session uses a frontier model such as `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`, `Gemini 4 Neon (High)`, `Gemini 4 Argon (High)`, or `Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium)`, any `invoke_subagent(TypeName="research", Model="inherit")` call **overrides `research.md`'s frontmatter model** (`model: flash_lite`). As a result, read-heavy exploratory `research` calls inadvertently inherit and drain your primary frontier model quota.

Because parent models frequently overlook prompt instructions not to pass `'inherit'`, this lifecycle hook intercepts `invoke_subagent` deterministically at the engine level, replacing `Model` with `"flash_lite"` **only when `TypeName == "research"`**. Other subagents (`worker`, `self`, etc.) are left untouched.

---

## Empirical Benchmark Results (`research` Subagent Only)

A deterministic multi-model A/B benchmark was conducted on a **Gemini AI Pro** subscription using fresh, isolated `agy -p --model <id>` sessions (zero leftover conversation history) on a single heavy 6-document comparative synthesis task delegated to `research` across Antigravity's internal customization documentation (`hooks.md`, `json_configs.md`, `mcp_servers.md`, `plugins.md`, `rules.md`, `skills.md` — ~33KB source text).

Each run invoked `invoke_subagent(TypeName="research", Model="inherit")` with live `/usage` quota snapshots measured immediately before and after that single `agy -p` dispatch. *(Percentage drains reflect a **Gemini AI Pro** quota pool and scale with your subscription tier.)*

| Metric | Run A (`flash_lite`, Plugin ON) | Run B — Hydrogen High (`inherit`) | Run B — Neon High (`inherit`) | Run B — Argon High (`inherit`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Observed `PLANNER_RESPONSE.model`** | `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` | `gemini-4-hydrogen-high` | `gemini-4-neon-high` | `gemini-4-argon-high` |
| **Benchmark-Run Quota Multiplier Savings** | **Baseline (`0.00%` / `< 0.01%` `research` drain)** | **2.20x Weekly / 2.67x 5-Hr lower run drain** (`-0.05% / -0.15%` ON vs `-0.11% / -0.40%` OFF) | **4.22x Weekly / 4.26x 5-Hr lower run drain** (`-0.09% / -0.31%` ON vs `-0.38% / -1.32%` OFF) | **3.26x lower Argon run drain** (`-0.38%` ON vs `-1.24%` OFF; **`0.00%` Argon** subagent drain) |

### Key Findings & Discussion

1. **Near-zero `research` subagent quota consumption (`< 0.01%`)**:
   In both **Argon (High)** and **Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium)** Plugin ON runs (where parent turns billed against Argon or Claude pools while `research` ran on `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`), the General Weekly (`89.00%`) and 5-Hour (`93.81%`) counters moved **`0.00%`**. Thus a `flash_lite` `research` subagent call consumes `< 0.01%` of General quota and **`0.00%`** of Argon or Claude/GPT quota.
2. **Argon & Claude pool preservation (`0.00%` subagent drain)**:
   When working with `Gemini 4 Argon (High)`, disabling the plugin raised total Argon Weekly drain from **`-0.38%`** (parent-only) to **`-1.24%`** (**3.26x** higher), meaning the unhooked `research` subagent alone consumed **`-0.86%`** of weekly Argon quota. With **Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium)** + Plugin ON, parent turns consumed `-3.70%` Weekly / `-7.39%` 5-Hour Claude quota while `research` ran on `flash_lite` with **`0.00%`** Claude quota drain *(Plugin OFF skipped to preserve remaining Claude quota)*.
3. **Fresh-session A/B multipliers on `Hydrogen` (`2.67x`) & `Neon` (`4.26x`)**:
   In isolated `agy -p` single-dispatch runs (one parent turn delegating to `research`), enabling the plugin reduced 5-Hour drain from `-0.40%` to `-0.15%` (**2.67x**, Weekly `-0.11%` → `-0.05%` = **2.20x**) on `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`, and from `-1.32%` to `-0.31%` (**4.26x**, Weekly `-0.38%` → `-0.09%` = **4.22x**) on `Gemini 4 Neon (High)`. These multipliers reflect a `research`-heavy single dispatch; sessions with fewer `research` calls or heavy parent/worker coding will see proportionally smaller overall savings.
4. **Hardened `agents/research.md` configuration**:
   The plugin also includes a hardened `agents/research.md` definition with explicit read-only instructions (`enable_write_tools: false`, return strictly via `send_message`). As observed during benchmarking, this prevents `research` from attempting tool workarounds on ambiguous tasks. Meanwhile, `agents/worker.md` intentionally remains unhooked on `flash` / parent model.

### Estimated Overall Session Impact

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The measured benchmark multipliers above apply **to `research` subagent dispatches ONLY**—primary parent turns, `worker`, and `self` subagents still bill against your selected model quota.

Because Google does not publish an Antigravity-wide breakdown of `research` vs. main-agent quota usage, total session impact depends on how much of your workflow is delegated to `research` rather than handled directly by the parent agent. Grounded in Microsoft's [*FastContext* paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14066) (**46.5%** of main-agent tokens and **56.2%** of tool turns spent reading/searching code), scaling the measured per-model `research` multipliers gives:

- **Small repos / targeted edits** (~10% `research` share): estimated total gains of **~22% on Hydrogen**, **~32% on Argon**, and **~44% on Neon**.
- **Unfamiliar repos / exploration-heavy workflows** (~50% `research` share): estimated total gains up to **~1.1x on Hydrogen**, **~1.63x on Argon**, and **~2.1x on Neon** *(plus secondary prompt-cache savings from keeping bulky reads out of the parent context)*.

Common **exploration-heavy workflows** that benefit most from delegating discovery to `research` include:
- **QA & bug triage**: reproducing symptoms, tracing execution paths, and inspecting logs/stack traces.
- **Code audits & security reviews**: scanning auth boundaries, data flows, and configuration surfaces across modules.
- **PR validation & impact analysis**: checking cross-file callers, breaking changes, and test coverage before merging.
- **Unfamiliar codebase onboarding**: mapping repository architecture, entry points, and conventions.
- **Large-scale refactoring discovery**: locating all symbol usages and edge cases before running edits.
- **Dependency, API & documentation synthesis**: comparing internal specs, schemas, or third-party SDK usage across files.

---

## Subagents Architecture (`agents/`)

This repository includes refined definitions for both primary subagents:

### 1. `agents/research.md` (Read-Only Explorer)
- **Role**: Codebase exploration, file search, documentation lookup, and web research.
- **Tools**: Read-only (`enable_write_tools: false`, `enable_mcp_tools: false`).
- **Hook Policy**: **Forced to `flash_lite` via hook**. Massive quota savings with zero risk of code corruption.

### 2. `agents/worker.md` (Mechanical Worker)
- **Role**: Focused edits, lint/format fixes, single-file patches, and narrow test runs.
- **Tools**: Write enabled (`enable_write_tools: true`).
- **Hook Policy**: **NOT forced to `flash_lite`**. `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` has higher error rates on exact-match whitespace diffs (`edit_file`) and recovery loops. To avoid file corruption or looping edits, `worker` remains on `flash` / parent model.
- **Guardrails**: Added strict pre-edit inspection (`read_file` first to copy whitespace byte-for-byte), scoped edits, and an explicit **fail visibly** policy that forbids speculative workarounds.

---

## Installation & Setup

### Option 1: Antigravity Plugin (Recommended)
Install directly from GitHub via the Antigravity CLI:
```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/carlosduplar/antigravity-research-flash-lite
```

Or clone locally and install from the directory (via CLI or `/plugin install <directory>` inside `agy`):
```bash
git clone https://github.com/carlosduplar/antigravity-research-flash-lite.git
```

# agy-ctx-ring **Zero-patch native composer HUD & click popovers for Antigravity — session stats, token usage, and native context breakdown.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v1.2.8-d97706?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/XMT-CN/agy-ctx-ring/releases/latest) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-16a34a?style=flat-square)](#architecture--privacy) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Windows-52525b?style=flat-square)](#quick-start) **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## Preview Mounted directly inside Antigravity's composer footer to the left of the `Turbo` trigger — borderless, responsive, and automatically inheriting Light/Dark CSS tokens and Google Sans Flex typography:

Clicking any of the three segments opens a compact floating popover right above the composer:

- **Session Stats (`会话统计`)**: turns, steps, model wall time, deduplicated tool call wall time, average TTFT, and decode speed (`tok/s`). - **Token Usage (`Token 用量`)**: cumulative total tokens, cache hit rate, uncached input, cache read, and output tokens. - **Context Window (`上下文窗口`)**: ring progress (`正常` / `占用偏高` / `接近上限`), compaction indicator (`已压缩`), used / remaining / window cap, per-request cache hit (with model-switch cold-start indicator), plus the **5-category breakdown** decoded from Antigravity's native `gen_metadata` (`系统提示与规则` · `子智能体与系统消息` · `工具调用与输出` · `模型思考与回复` · `用户输入`). --- ## Features - **Zero-Patch Upgrade Survival**: Never modifies `Antigravity.app`, `app.asar`, or `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. Installed cleanly under `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ctx-ring/` so official Antigravity updates never wipe your HUD. - **API Ground-Truth Prompt Usage & Native Breakdown**: Tracks server-returned prompt tokens (`uncached input + cache read`, aligned with Antigravity's actual compaction trigger) and scales the 5-category breakdown from Antigravity's native `gen_metadata` context tree (`ctx[3]`), isolating subagent / plan handoff `SYSTEM_MESSAGE` payloads from static system rules (with full-transcript `transcript_full.jsonl` fallback). - **Zero-Latency Session Switching**: - Preloads the 40 most recent conversations into browser memory on attach; - Hooks Chromium `window.navigation` (`currententrychange`), `popstate`, and a `queueMicrotask` `MutationObserver` to re-render in the same paint frame (~0 ms); - Registers a CDP `Runtime.addBinding` wakeup channel so fresh SQLite metrics sync in ~5–15 ms without waiting for polling intervals. - **Instant New-Chat Reset**: Resets cleanly to `0 轮 0 步 · 0 tok · 0%` on `/` or before a conversation `.db` exists (no stale data leaked from previous chats). - **Headless Sidecar (`has_web_ui: false`)**: Adds zero extra sidebar tabs or Auxiliary Pane clutter, and runs directly on Antigravity's bundled Node 24 runtime with zero npm dependencies. --- ## Quick Start ### macOS / Linux (One-Liner) ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XMT-CN/agy-ctx-ring/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XMT-CN/agy-ctx-ring/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### Manual Installation (`git clone`) ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/XMT-CN/agy-ctx-ring.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ctx-ring bash ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ctx-ring/scripts/install.sh ``` ### After Installing 1. **Quit Antigravity completely** if it is currently running without `--remote-debugging-port=0`. 2. **Launch Antigravity via `Antigravity (HUD)`**: - **macOS**: Open `~/Applications/Antigravity (HUD).app` (pin it to your Dock), or run: ```bash open -a "Antigravity" --args --remote-debugging-port=0 ``` - **Linux**: Use the `Antigravity (HUD)` application entry, or run: ```bash antigravity --remote-debugging-port=0 ``` - **Windows**: Double-click the `Antigravity (HUD)` shortcut created on your Desktop. 3. Verify **上下文胶囊 (`agy-ctx-ring`)** is enabled under **Customizations → Plugins**. --- ## Architecture & Privacy ```mermaid flowchart LR A["~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/*.db
(SQLite readOnly)"] --> B["Headless Sidecar
Antigravity Node 24"] B -->|"127.0.0.1 DevToolsActivePort (CDP)"| C["Antigravity Workbench
Composer Footer & Popovers"] C -->|"Runtime.addBinding instant wakeup"| B ``` - **100% Local & Read-Only**: Opens conversation SQLite files with `{ readOnly: true }`, reads `gen_metadata` and `steps` strictly locally, makes **zero** outbound network requests, and never writes to Antigravity's database or `config.json`. - **Zero External Dependencies**: Uses Antigravity's built-in `node:sqlite`, global `WebSocket`, and `fetch` — nothing to compile or `npm install`. --- ## Update & Uninstall ### Update Re-run the one-line installer for your OS, or pull directly if installed via `git`: ```bash git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ctx-ring pull --ff-only ``` Then toggle the plugin off/on in **Customizations → Plugins** (or restart Antigravity). ### Uninstall **macOS / Linux:** ```bash bash ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-ctx-ring/scripts/uninstall.sh ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-ctx-ring" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item -Force ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop') + '\Antigravity (HUD).lnk') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue ``` > Both uninstall paths leave `Antigravity.app` and `~/.gemini/config/config.json` untouched. --- ## FAQ
Why is the --remote-debugging-port=0 launcher needed? To keep the plugin completely non-invasive and immune to Antigravity auto-updates, `agy-ctx-ring` never patches `app.asar`. Instead, it injects the composer HUD at runtime over Antigravity's loopback-only `127.0.0.1` CDP port (`DevToolsActivePort`). Launching via `Antigravity (HUD)` simply passes `--remote-debugging-port=0` cleanly for you.
Why does Context Limit show 512K or 256K instead of 1M? The plugin reads Antigravity's own per-conversation context ceiling field (`ctx[4]`), which is the actual compaction threshold Antigravity enforces (currently `512K` for Gemini 4 models and `256K` for Gemini 3.8 Flash), matching when Antigravity prompts you to compact.
The HUD bar didn't appear after enabling the plugin — what should I check? Make sure you fully quit any pre-existing Antigravity instance and launched via `Antigravity (HUD)` (with `--remote-debugging-port=0`). If launched normally without that flag, Chromium does not create `DevToolsActivePort` and runtime injection cannot attach.
